name: Model2Vec GitHub repository (Minish static embeddings)
notes: README: 'Fast State-of-the-Art Static Embeddings'. Model2Vec distils a sentence-transformer into a static embedding model, giving 'significant reductions in model size and inference speed' per the model2vec-rs README. Ships MTEB, MMTEB, retrieval and training result tables in the repo under results/. MIT licensed, published on PyPI as model2vec. Software citation provided (minishlab2024model2vec, Stephan Tulkens and van Dongen). API metadata 2026-10-04: created 2024-07-18, last push 2026-10-02, 2222 stars, 128 forks, only 2 open issues, not archived, no GitHub releases, homepage minish.ai/packages/model2vec/introduction.
